facts.fact: 卡森坐在软垫检查台上，牛仔裤折放一旁，盯着靠在对面椅子上的假肢；未戴上时它像一件与自己分离的物件。
facts.anchor: I sat on the edge of a padded table with my jeans folded beside me and stared at my prosthetic leg resting upright against the chair across from me.

facts.fact: 物理治疗师 Hannah 把凳子挪近，检查卡森残肢上受刺激的皮肤，卡森则假装看对面墙上的解剖海报。
facts.anchor: My physical therapist, Hannah, rolled her stool closer and examined the irritated skin along my residual limb

facts.fact: 卡森向 Hannah 承认，两周前（two weeks ago）曾冒雨步行了几英里（a couple miles）。
facts.anchor: I walked a couple miles in the rain two weeks ago.

facts.fact: 卡森解释步行原因：卡车抛锚（truck broke down），车里放着牛奶且没有手机服务，于是走路。
Hannah 表示可调整假肢适配，并要求卡森几天内（a few days）减轻负荷、别太逞强。
facts.anchor: take it easier for a few days

facts.fact: 卡森说丰收节（Harvest Festival）不到一个月就到了，二十多人（Twenty-something people）已把他的农场当成社区项目。
facts.anchor: Twenty-something people have apparently decided my property is their personal community project.
